comparison.derivation: A floating reset-state input draws no more than the sourced maximum leakage.
comparison.reset_state: Factory fuses (JTAGEN programmed, HWBE programmed, low-power crystal oscillator): port pins tri-stated (7766J p68) except the JTAG pull-ups on PF4/PF5/PF7 (p6, p355); PE2/HWB an input (p340); RESET with its pull-up RRST (p384). DC values are preliminary design targets (p385).

io_leak_max.detail: Input Leakage Current I/O Pin VCC = 5.5V, pin low (absolute value) 1 uA (IIH pin high 1 uA, p384)
io_leak_max.scope: ATmega32U4 TQFP-44; Atmel-7766J 04/2016; Table 29-1 IIL/IIH, VCC = 5.5V, absolute value; PRELIMINARY design target (Table 29-1 note 5)

supply_max.scope: ATmega32U4 TQFP-44; Atmel-7766J 04/2016; Operating Voltages, industrial

limits: Reset-state electrical check of one pin with every rail at its sourced recommended maximum: the pin, shorted to ground, must draw only its sourced leakage (floating input) or its sourced pull-up current. Firmware, clocks, peripherals and output drive are not modeled; the leakage term of the hashed pad is zero, so the leakage check bounds the model from above only.
